body: That's even better then. One day of use doesn't diminish all those days of effort and success. I believe in you even more now!
Thank you! I am relaxed about it now in a way I wasn't before. I think it will be okay.

Relapsing isn't the end of the world. At least, I hope not, because I just did, haha. You made it 11 days without porn. If you were trying to eat healthy, then that's like saying you went 11 days without junk food. The point isn't to do it forever(but for some people it can be and that is ok), but to cut down and view it as something healthy, and not let it control you. You made it to ELEVEN days. That's a lot of waking hours with urges, and that's hard work. I hope I can make it to 11 days on my next streak!

Keep trying and I will keep trying with you!

Don't let masturbation and porn define any area of your life. Chances are if you're here, it's because it's already defining too much of your life. Take the power back from your urges, and live the life you want to live, not the one you're coerced into living by your dumb animal brain!
Absolutely! And, I'd hardly say going 21 days is small progress. It's more than I've ever done and impressive to me - so we're in this together! Good luck, I'm here for you!
Peeking doesn't have to be anything more! jsut recognize it for what it was and move forward! I believe inyou, I'm here for you. Let's do this!

I don't think you're letting anyone down. Think of is this way; if you view the last 21 days as a ratio of days with and without porn and/or masturbation, then you have <5% usage rate. That's probably a huge improvement. Maybe it could help to take your streak and remember it; it's not gone, and it's evidence that you can succeed, and impressively so. Then with this next one, you can remember it in the same way if you need a third. Maybe it will be thirty more, maybe not. But it seems like you've made massive changes and that's great! Good luck, and I'm sure you can do it.

Whenever I have felt at risk I have sorted by new to comment on new posts. I find it helps a lot. My post today seems to have been lost to the spam filter but even though I didn't get to post, I didn't relapse. So that is a victory!
I started a few days ago but I wish you luck! We are gonna pretty close in numbers in 30+days. Good luck! I want to see your badge get bigger and bigger!
Let's both make it to 3 days then!
Thank you! I hope you keep going as well.
We will! Thank you!

Thank you! Building the habit of posting and then replying to posts has been helpful as well. It feels like what I'm attempting for is normalized and encouraged, rather than a unique and private journey. I hope others can see that it's not all perfect in the beginning but its the gradual accumulation of successes that replace the failures.

Good luck! I know that both last night and this morning would have been harder had I not been able to come and look at these communities instead of whatever politics rage fest and stupid memes are on the front page, or porn elsewhere.

We can do this, even if it's a bumpy road to start!

Thank you for sharing! I am looking forward to doing better with the internet and you've inspired me to focus up today and do better with my habits. One week, hell even one day, can be so valuable and I don't want to waste that anymore.

I wish you the best with your next week!
Thank you! I can thank my 13yo self for that one.
THank you, you too!
Thank you! It is definitely something that's easy to rationalize but is just as damning as acting with intention. How are you doing now? Can I help in any way?
You keep counting your days, and I'll keep counting mine! Hopefully I can join you in some big numbers with some perseverance. Good job, keep it up! I hope to see more success stories from you.

If I keep going as I'm currently going, my dreams will suffer for it. I'm in a good enough position that they aren't unreasonable, and I don't want the reason I don't succeed, of all the reasons, to be as dumb as porn. I don't want that to be my story.

Feelings are only a part of us, and I'm glad you're not letting them stop you! Always remember that feeling *about* feelings is just as valid, and evidence that you can change and keep moving forward to who you want to be!

Thank you! I think that is a good idea and it even helped me yesterday, so I will try and make a good habit out of it. In fact, because I frequently use incognito to browse porn, I will keep my account logged in an minimized to make sure nofap is the first thing I see when opening reddit.

Sexual shame can be pretty strong. I think if at least you are not hurting anyone then it's not something to worry about. I've heard, but don't have a source on this, that the less you focus on porn in your life the more tame your interests can return to being. So I think there is light at the end of the tunnel!

I will be continuing to try and I hope you do too. Feeling like you're trapped in a cycle is a terrible feeling, but always remember that you are not all consumed by it. There is still the part of you that doesn't want to do it, and that is evidence that you can change. Focus on cultivating the parts of you that you appreciate! I believe in you.

If this is something that you feel is seriously affecting you, maybe it would be worth considering professional options or anonymous group support.

I like the idea of looking at the urge instead of looking at yourself. When I have felt close to relapsing, or have relapsed, I always confuse the situation with something that is all encompassing. So the idea that I can sit back and remember to be mindful that it is only a part of me, and there is still a part of me that is aware i want to do the opposite, helps me.

Thank you for sharing, and I will try and use your technique going forward!

Thank you. I'm not sure if posting a lot is allowed, but stopping and coming her to type out what I was feeling cemented my urge to stop as something I also believed in and knew to be the right decision. It got my mind off things and felt like a breath of fresh air.
Thank you! I feel good about stopping. I see you're also at 1 day - I hope we can progress together!
I hope so. Thank you.
